explanation: A shredder hidden in the frame sliced the lower half into strips. The artist renamed the work Love is in the Bin.

claims.text: In October 2018, moments after it sold at Sotheby's in London, Banksy's Girl with Balloon was partly shredded by a device hidden in its frame.
At the sale, Girl with Balloon did not catch fire, fall off a wall or change colour.
The shredder cut about the lower half of the canvas into strips.
After the sale the shredded work was renamed Love is in the Bin.
